qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's student (PhD candidates not eligible)
At least 6 semesters of full-time university study
description_short: CERN invites Bachelor's and Master's students of all nationalities to apply for its 2027 Summer Student Programme, an onsite placement in Geneva. Nationals of Canada, Japan and the US apply through separate national portals.
